Garden Fencing in Northwood

Northwood is one of the greenest corners of North West London, surrounded by Copse Wood, Ruislip Woods and open countryside towards Moor Park. Many homes here have generous gardens and long boundaries, so good, solid fencing really matters. Albi Driveways is based just down the road in Ruislip and has more than 27 years' experience [PLACEHOLDER: confirm 27+ years] working on gardens across Northwood and Northwood Hills.

Fencing for Northwood's larger gardens

Northwood has many large detached and semi-detached homes, often from the early and mid-twentieth century, with big back gardens. That usually means:

  • Longer runs of fencing, sometimes on more than one side of the garden.
  • More exposure to wind, especially for gardens backing onto woodland or open ground.
  • Privacy between neighbouring gardens and from nearby paths.

We put up new fencing, replace old or leaning fences, and help after storm damage [PLACEHOLDER: confirm you take on storm repair/replacement call-outs]. We will help you choose fencing that suits your garden and budget [PLACEHOLDER: confirm fence types offered (panels, posts, gravel boards etc.)].

Local things to think about

  • Woodland edges: If your garden backs onto Copse Wood, Ruislip Woods or other green space, a well-built fence helps keep your garden secure and private. Posts need to be set firmly to cope with exposed spots.
  • Trees: Mature trees are common in Northwood gardens. We plan fence lines around roots and trees. Some trees in the area may have Tree Preservation Orders, so check with Hillingdon Council if you are unsure [PLACEHOLDER: confirm TPO wording].
  • Height and conservation areas: A garden fence can usually be up to 2 metres without planning permission, or 1 metre next to a road or footpath. Parts of Northwood are in conservation areas, where extra rules may apply [PLACEHOLDER: confirm conservation-area wording].
